elfprototype:Chime.NAME: Chime
DESCRIPTIONS: Flipped #b
time(s) this turn. Elf cards deal + #b
damage per hit and gain that much more #yBlock. Resets at end of turn.

elfprototype:Resonance.NAME: Resonance
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever #yChime reaches a multiple of #b3, gain #b{N} energy.

elfprototype:Recollection.NAME: Recollection
DESCRIPTIONS: The first #b{N} Seals each turn draw #b1 card each.

elfprototype:Bloodblades.NAME: Bloodblades
DESCRIPTIONS: Cursed attacks deal #b{N} more damage per hit.

elfprototype:Radiance.NAME: Radiance
DESCRIPTIONS: Light cards get double #yChime on #yBlock.

elfprototype:BacklashEcho.NAME: Backlash Echo
DESCRIPTIONS: When #yBacklash costs HP, deal HP lost x#b{N} damage to ALL enemies.

elfprototype:Composure.NAME: Composure
DESCRIPTIONS: At the end of your turn, gain #b{N} #yBlock for each light card in your hand.

elfprototype:CreepingCurse.NAME: Creeping Curse
DESCRIPTIONS: After drawing each turn, #yErode the leftmost #b{N} light card(s) in your hand.

elfprototype:Vigil.NAME: Vigil
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you #ySeal a card, gain #b{N} #yBlock.

elfprototype:Penance.NAME: Penance
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you #ySeal a card each turn, gain #b{N} energy.

elfprototype:MoonAwakening.NAME: Moon Awakening
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you #yErode a card, draw #b{N} card(s). Whenever you #ySeal a card, gain #b{N} energy.

elfprototype:NextAttack.NAME: Honed
DESCRIPTIONS: Your next attack this turn deals #b{N} more damage.

elfprototype:NextLightAttack.NAME: Gathered Light
DESCRIPTIONS: Your next light attack this turn deals #b{N} more damage.

elfprototype:Afterglow.NAME: Afterglow
DESCRIPTIONS: At the end of your turn, #yChime is only halved.

elfprototype:Evernight.NAME: Evernight
DESCRIPTIONS: Cursed attacks hit #b{N} more time(s).

elfprototype:CursedHeart.NAME: Cursed Heart
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you #yBacklash, gain #b{N} #yStrength.

elfprototype:LightOath.NAME: Light Oath
DESCRIPTIONS: Light cards get double #yChime on damage and #yBlock.

elfprototype:TwinSoul.NAME: Twin Soul
DESCRIPTIONS: This turn, light cards #yErode themselves after being played and return to your hand.

elfprototype:NoBacklash.NAME: Steady
DESCRIPTIONS: No #yBacklash at the end of this turn.

elfprototype:NockLight.NAME: Nock
DESCRIPTIONS: Your next light attack this turn deals #b{N} more damage.

elfprototype:NockCursed.NAME: Bide
DESCRIPTIONS: Your next cursed attack this turn deals #b{N} more damage per hit.

elfprototype:EchoLight.NAME: Echo (light)
DESCRIPTIONS: This turn, your next #b{N} light card(s) are played twice.

elfprototype:EchoCursed.NAME: Echo (cursed)
DESCRIPTIONS: This turn, your next #b{N} cursed card(s) are played twice.
